what: Two circles slightly larger than the button (110%) overlap at its center — on hover the accent circle spreads from the center 0→1 over .3s (sine.out) and covers the background, and on leave the background-color circle spreads from the center 0→1 and covers the accent again. Both when entering and leaving, the new color always spreads from the center

options.--fx-fill: Color that spreads on hover (via style), default var(--kf-accent)
options.--fx-base: Resting background color (via style), default var(--kf-ink)
options.--fx-size: Circle diameter (relative to button width, via style), default 110%

note: Two circles (data-fx-part=fill·base) are created and inserted by the part if absent, and removed on detach. On touch devices only the background color is painted and it does not spread (the original also hides the accent circle on phones)
